translation_notes: Right-swaps the last two ordering positions before a codimension-at-least-two crossing, then applies the complete facet gluing permutation.
Codimension two compares the complete return ordering in dimensions above two; larger codimension compares only the selected face-vertex prefix.
Computes the relative permutation on complementary ordering positions and marks a link nonorientable exactly when this return permutation is odd.
Immutable finite queues and class records replace mutable face pointers, mapping tables, and flags while retaining separate bad-identification and link-orientation results.
Boundary edges contribute one and interior edges two to endpoint vertex links; invalid edges omit the second endpoint contribution as in the source.
Computes (2 v_int + v_bdry - f)/2 with a local signed representation and records whether the numerator is even.
Boundary chi=1 is real boundary; non-boundary chi=2 is finite; other non-boundary vertices are ideal; ideal chi=0 remains standard.

Combines certified reciprocal pairings, translated bad-identification checks, and the real-boundary Euler test; deliberately not named isValid because explicit link triangulations and complete boundary machinery remain absent.
Checks codimension rules, ordinary orientable links, orientation-normalised return tables, a reversed edge, and a nonorientable vertex link without a face self-identification.
Checks signed halving, disc and sphere links, the ball-bundle disc, the figure-eight Euler-zero ideal link, aggregate ideal/standard flags, and failure on a reversed edge.
